stage: Prospective M71 dictionary/support/coordinate diagnostic, no fitting
population: All18 fixed M70 states and all14 existing source-group evaluation pairs, both endpoints, source/final/identity. Familiar development data only, no selection or training.
question: Separate limited dictionary span, limited selected supports, and inaccurate coefficients as explanations for encoded-change failures. No more loss-weight or amplitude tuning.
local_interventions: For each aligned position, orthogonally project the exact native donor-minus-recipient write into (1) recipient selected atom span, (2) union of donor+recipient selected atoms, (3) full128-atom dictionary span. Normalize columns exactly as decoder. Use float64 SVD, retain singular values >1e-10 times largest; empty/zero span maps to zero. No ridge/grid/norm matching. Preserve actual encoded direction as control. Shared group supports use union so atoms counted once.
verification: Independently reconstruct supports from frozen encoder/membership and saved original writes; check ties and saved codes. Projection residual orthogonality, idempotence and span nesting. Assert local errors full<=union<=recipient and union<=actual encoded (within numerical tolerance), since actual difference belongs to union. Record rank and numerical residuals, never silently repair. Fix source/protocol before native intervention.
causal_test: Use original native recipient background and fixed native teacher; apply the three projected native directions plus actual encoded control at same positions. Every actual control must replay M70 native-background/reconstructed-direction result. Identity remains zero. Independent applied-vector and full-final-response audit.
metrics: Raw/local error, support/rank, full-vocabulary response errors, answer margins, family and pooled scores for every model/site. Record absolute target energies; no selecting strongest tasks.
interpretation: Teacher-informed projections are diagnostics, not deployable featurizers or generalization. They minimize Euclidean local error, not downstream loss; failure of the full-span projection is NOT proof no causally adequate vector exists in that span. Union beating actual causally supports coefficient/encoder limitations; full beating union suggests useful excluded directions. Mixed metrics retained.
stop: One fixed projection diagnostic and audit, then choose a representation change based on mechanism, not another objective sweep. Keep broader manifold/held-out-task discovery requirements unfulfilled until tested.
